features_merged_since_previous_baseline: infra/layers2-b1 (Python/Rust layer checks, the pre-commit module checks): no change to the language
fix/env-field-types (environment profile fields on the block routes): no change to what a translator can state
language_change_for_udhr: none. Nothing merged since ve-green-wire-s4 changes what the UDHR can say, so every difference to the previous run is a repair of the previous audit or of a defect it exposed, not progress of the language.
language_findings: no new language feature reached the UDHR between ve-green-wire-s4 and ve-green-env-profiles; the work of this run is the repair of the previous audit (nine of 20 sampled units rejected, eight of them for one defect)

the defect that decided the run: rights@0 content and readings@1 content cannot sit beside norm-defaults@0, so every candidate they held declared the completion 'deny' (obligations: 'not required') or 'permission deny' (liberties: 'not permitted'), which the source never states. The 39 units that had it (25 stated last run, 14 older right units, including three the 2026-10-02 audit had accepted) are re-stated as norm-defaults@0 companions; the main document no longer needs rights@0, soft-norms@0 or readings@1, and its load, check and render take under a second (previous run: 1,537 s load, 1,569 s check, refused at the tag's own 120 s limit)

what that costs: a candidate's content lives in a companion document, not in the main document, so the premise verdict stays UNKNOWN (reading elaboration pending) and VE does not compare candidates of one set (no separating situations, no SeparatedByActOnly findings); rights lose their holder and conflict checks (plain norms stand in for claims and liberties)

defaults beside soft norms: soft-norms@0 and norm-defaults@0 cannot share a document (document check: 'await the Lean route'), so a defeasible reading cannot leave the other cases unspecified. u017 ('should') therefore loses its defeasible reading and becomes UNFORMALISED (defaults); u111's four defeasible candidates are removed because the text states no exception

admissible readings only: the strict/defeasible twins of every 'shall' and of Articles 22-27's rights are gone (no exception is stated); u081 alone gets a candidate qualified by the organization and resources of each State, as a checked necessary condition over the named open relation resources_allow, because the clause is in Article 22 itself

explicit enumerations are checked structure: torture and treatment-or-punishment that is cruel, inhuman or degrading (u027, punishment explicitly covered), privacy, family, home and correspondence (u045a), slavery and servitude, the three statuses of u020, arrest, detention and exile, and the free and full consent of u059 are case-sort predicates under a guard; 'arbitrary' and 'cruel' stay open terms as base predicates the guard requires

English of the generated sentences: a unary base predicate renders natively only as '{0} is X' with one word X; of the base predicates introduced here the ones that fit are worded that way and the others render as 'classified as "..."' (the full clause is in the predicate description and the candidate's admission text)

limits unchanged from the previous run and still blocking: act-phrase grammar (11 units), time (5), causation (4), comparison (2), quantities (1), grounding of authority (1), priority of rights (1), right_lines across open sets (4), attribution, modality/belief, evaluative claims; none of these moved

passive duties name no bearer: u025, u098, u099a, u099b, u100a, u100b, u059 are read on a State or on every State, group and person; u098 also as a duty of a person of the age the source does not state (a named open relation)

no_invented_permissions.companions: every regulated predicate of the 124 companion documents declares the completion 'unspecified' ({'obligation:unspecified': 123, 'permission:unspecified': 19}); the status witnesses show a case outside a rule's guard UNDECIDED, never 'not required' and never permitted
no_invented_permissions.main_document: one regulated predicate remains: compel_association_membership_permitted (u074, permission, completion 'allow') under a rule whose guard is top, so the completion is never consulted; unchanged and audited faithful. No other regulated predicate, so no declared completion for any other act
no_invented_permissions.scope: the State readings are rules over the sort State (parties that are not States are not mentioned), the anyone readings over every State, group and person
